name: mosaic-device-provider
title: MosaicDeviceProvider
description: Responsive device context provider. Exposes isMobile/isTablet/isDesktop, sm/md/lg/xl breakpoint flags, orientation, viewport size. Hooks: useDevice, useBreakpoint, useIsMobile, useIsTablet, useIsDesktop, useViewport, useOrientation. SSR-safe. Required by all adaptive components.
